title: Dilation push-forward x ↦ λx on currents in ℝ^P: algebra, mass scaling, integrality, ∂, supports, explicit action and the Hᵏ change of variables
statement: Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)); X − Y is the contract subtraction (pointwise on test forms). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors (covectorEuclideanNorm); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U is the contract structure IMRep U d; R represents X when X(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHᵈ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), where ⟨ω, ξ⟩(x) = ξ(x)(ω(x)); μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M is R.measure and R.action(β) = ∫_M θ ξ(β) dHᵈ for any d-form β; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off a set E if X(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from E. For every P ∈ ℕ there is an operation dil assigning to every k ∈ ℕ, λ ∈ ℝ and X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) (domain univ) a current dil_k(λ, X) ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) such that for every k and every λ > 0: (1) dil_k(λ, X − Y) = dil_k(λ, X) − dil_k(λ, Y); (2) dil_k(λ⁻¹, dil_k(λ, X)) = X; (3) M(dil_k(λ, X)) = λ^k·M(X); (4) dil_k(λ, X) is IM whenever X is; (5) ∂dil_{k+1}(λ, X) = dil_k(λ, ∂X) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P); (6) if X vanishes off E then dil_k(λ, X) vanishes off λE = {λx : x ∈ E}; (7) for every X and ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) there is η ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with η(x) = λ^k ω(λx) for all x and dil_k(λ, X)(ω) = X(η); (8) for every A ⊆ ℝ^P and g : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{λA} g dHᵏ = λ^k ∫_A g(λx) dHᵏ(x). (dil_k(λ, ·) is the push-forward by x ↦ λx, Simon's change of scale between 5.1 and 5.3.)
lean_statement: ∀ P : ℕ, ∃ dil : ∀ k : ℕ, ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, ∀ (k : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, dil k lam (X - Y) = dil k lam X - dil k lam Y) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, dil k lam⁻¹ (dil k lam X) = X) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (dil k lam X).mass = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ k) * X.mass) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity (dil k lam X)) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), (dil (k + 1) lam X).boundary = dil k lam X.boundary) ∧ (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (E : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → X ω = 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) ((fun x => lam • x) '' E) → dil k lam X ω = 0) ∧ (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = lam ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (lam • x)) ∧ dil k lam X ω = X η) ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), ∫ y in (fun x => lam • x) '' A, g y ∂μHE[k] = lam ^ k * ∫ x in A, g (lam • x) ∂μHE[k]
